title: Undercurrents Surging
next_chapter_hook: At the moment when Chen Ji was about to make his judgment, Ling Yuan's eyes suddenly became vacant, and a pressure beyond mortal will erupted from within him—the Heavenly Eye had finally entered the game itself.

text.content: The night wind turned sharply cold. Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back at the cliff's edge, Han Lie's retreating figure still visible in the fading twilight, when Mo Xiansheng's aged and urgent voice exploded in his mind like thunder. His expression unchanged, his heart was already churning with giant waves—the remnant projection of the Tianji Record's original master? That existence revered as the standard by generations of prophets, actually lurking in this hidden manner within the Xuanwu Sect's number one genius. His knuckles tightened slightly, Chen Ji's gaze as deep and condensed as an abyss, yet the corner of his lips curved into a nonchalant arc: 'Interesting. It seems this chess game is more complicated than I imagined.'

dialogue.content: "The young master truly remains unruffled." An aged and familiar voice came from the depths of the night. Amidst the pine waves, a stooped figure slowly emerged from the shadows—it was precisely the former Tianqing Sect Grand Elder, Ling Yuan. He held an ancient paper lantern, his turbid eyes flickering with a brilliance entirely different from before. "This old man has been waiting here for quite some time."

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze deepened slightly, his eyes scanning around Ling Yuan like blades. The old elder's aura tonight was particularly strange—neither wearing his former mask of kindhearted hypocrisy, nor the rumored depths of cunning strategy, but a kind of almost liberating candor. The pine waves carried the damp chill of night dew. Chen Ji silently spread his divine sense outward—no ambush within a hundred zhang. He sneered in his heart: true candor, or luring the enemy deeper?

dialogue.content: "There is no need for the young master to test." Ling Yuan coughed lightly, his withered hand slowly tearing open his chest garment, exposing the old, shriveled chest—where, a terrifying black pattern coiled like a serpent over his heart, emanating a chilling aura that made one's heart tremble. "This is the brand the Heavenly Eye engraved upon my soul. Three hundred years ago, it used this to control me and make me its chess piece."

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted. The Heavenly Eye's soul brand—what this meant, he understood better than anyone. The Tianji Record Fragment trembled slightly in the depths of his consciousness, transmitting Mo Xiansheng's sharp intake of breath: "Young master, this old servant recognizes this brand... it is indeed a mark of the Heavenly Will. But why would this old man take the initiative to expose it?" Chen Ji's expression remained calm, yet his heart was already churning with giant waves: was Ling Yuan revealing his cards, or was this a risky move in a much larger game?

dialogue.content: "This old man has waited for this day far too long." Ling Yuan's voice was hoarse and weary. "Three hundred years ago, the Tianji Record chose Chen Xuan over me. I thought that was heaven's injustice. But later I understood—we people are merely chess pieces on heaven's chessboard." His turbid eyes gazed directly at Chen Ji. "Young master, the Tianji Record Fragment in your hand is the only variable in this game. This old man is willing to wield the sword for you, only asking that on the day you break the局—let me personally sever this brand."

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan's surrender came too suddenly. Chen Ji needed more筹码 to judge truth from falsehood. How to deal with this former secret enemy?

choices.description: Neither trust nor reject, use words to probe Ling Yuan's bottom line, see how he responds to tricky questions
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more intelligence about the Heavenly Eye
choices.risk_hint: May expose the extent of his own understanding of the Tianji Record

dialogue.content: "Since the old master was a chess piece controlled for three hundred years, you must have deep knowledge of the Tianji Record's original master." Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, his gaze casually sweeping across the brand on Ling Yuan's chest. "Dare I ask, what kind of existence is that remnant projection...?"

A trace of approval flickered in Ling Yuan's turbid eyes. His枯瘦 fingers traced the black pattern over his heart: "The original master... Hmph, it calls itself 'Tianshu,' a will formed from the residual obsessions of fallen prophets across generations." The voice suddenly lowered. "It is not the true master of the Tianji Record, but rather... a usurper."

choices.text: Reveal the Tianji Record to verify truth
choices.description: Boldly display the Tianji Record Fragment, observe Ling Yuan's reaction, use the Tianji Record's own repelling nature to verify the truth of his words
choices.visible_cost: Expose the existence of the Tianji Record Fragment
choices.visible_reward: Obtain direct evidence of whether Ling Yuan is recognized by the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: If Ling Yuan has ulterior motives, this move would be no different than revealing one's own cards

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze sharpened. The Tianji Record Fragment in his palm suddenly manifested. Ancient golden patterns radiated faint light in the night. The black brand on Ling Yuan's chest actually began to agitate and contract restlessly, as if encountering a natural enemy. His turbid eyes suddenly widened, a suppressed groan escaping his throat: "This, this aura... it's real! The Tianji Record has acknowledged you!" His knees softened, and the堂堂老掌门 actually knelt and bowed before the Fragment.

choices.description: Expose with sharp words the scheme behind Ling Yuan's seemingly candid words, pointing out he is not真心 surrendering but has a greater agenda
choices.visible_reward: See through Ling Yuan's true intentions
choices.risk_hint: If judgment is wrong, may lose a potential ally

dialogue.content: "These words from the old master are quite sincere indeed." Chen Ji coldly laughed, pacing with hands behind his back for two circles. "But three hundred years ago, knowing the Heavenly Eye's schemes, you were an accomplice; thirty years ago, you stood by as the Chen family was destroyed; ten years ago, you found every which way to make things difficult for me—now seeing the wind has shifted, you come to pour out your heart?" His gaze suddenly chilled. "Do you take Chen Ji for a three-year-old child?"

Ling Yuan's form stiffened slightly, then burst into a bleak laughter: "Good! Good indeed, Chen Ji!" The laughter abruptly stopped, a trace of tears actually appearing in his turbid eyes. "You are right, I indeed deserve death. But young master... this old man came here today, not to beg your forgiveness, only wanting to... be my true self before you break the局."

As Chen Ji was about to speak, Mo Xiansheng's voice rang again in his consciousness, carrying rare gravity: "Young master, please wait. This old servant just carefully sensed—the brand on Ling Yuan is indeed real, but... the will sealed within is not completely dormant. It is waiting, lurking, like a poisonous snake disguised as a rope." Pausing, Mo Xiansheng's voice grew even lower. "More importantly, this old servant sensed a faint connection... between that brand and the Tianji Record Fragment, there seems to be some kind of resonance."

text.content: Chen Ji's heart tightened. The Tianji Record resonating with the Heavenly Eye's brand—what did this mean? Could it be that the Tianji Record itself had some inseparable connection with the Heavenly Eye? His expression remained normal, yet a deep chill flickered in the depths of his eyes. Ling Yuan was still awaiting his response. The night wind stirred his grizzled temples, the black brand on his chest looking like a hideous serpent under the moonlight.

dialogue.content: "The young master seems to have doubts." A hint of bitter smile appeared on Ling Yuan's aged face. He slowly drew an ancient jade slip from his sleeve. "This is all the intelligence about the Heavenly Eye this old man has collected over these three hundred years—its布局, its chess pieces, its weaknesses." The jade slip gleamed coldly under the moonlight. "This old man knows, merely these are insufficient to gain trust. But young master..." He raised his turbid eyes. "Do you have any other choices?"

choice.prompt: The筹码 Ling Yuan threw out were tempting enough, but the dangers within were equally obvious. Chen Ji had to make a decision.

choices.description: Agree to cooperate with Ling Yuan, but use the Tianji Record's power to附加 restrictions on his brand, ensuring he cannot betray
choices.visible_reward: Obtain Ling Yuan's allegiance and intelligence
choices.risk_hint: May触怒 the Heavenly Will within the brand
choices.process_label: 以天机录施加灵魂禁制

text.content: After沉吟, Chen Ji's palm manifested the Tianji Record Fragment again. He flicked a finger, and a strand of golden light entered the hideous black brand on Ling Yuan's chest. Ling Yuan convulsed violently, a complex expression of fear and relief flickering across his face: "This is... the Tianji Record's seal?" Chen Ji淡淡道: "Not a seal, but insurance. If the old master has ulterior motives, with one thought I can cause this brand to rebound."

choices.text: First examine the jade slip intelligence before deciding
choices.description: Not rush to decide, first take the jade slip and carefully study the intelligence within, confirm the truth of Ling Yuan's words before making plans
choices.risk_hint: May fall into an intelligence trap

dialogue.content: "I'll take the intelligence." Chen Ji reached for the jade slip, his divine sense slowly probing within. In an instant, countless images flickered through his mind like a parade—layouts of the Heavenly Eye, lists of chess pieces across generations, the calamities it stirred in different epochs... His pupils suddenly contracted: "These... are real?" Deep within the jade slip, a hidden restriction quivered slightly, as if warning of something.

Seeing this, Ling Yuan's withered lips slightly raised: "The young master is indeed cautious. Very good." He stood with hands clasped behind his back, gazing toward the faintly red clouds on the distant horizon. "This old man will tell the young master one more thing—the Heavenly Eye is not invincible. It has a fatal weakness, located at..." Before he could finish, the black brand on his chest suddenly剧烈蠕动起来. Ling Yuan's face drastically changed, his hands死死按住心口, letting out a painful groan.

text.content: Chen Ji's瞳孔微缩. The Heavenly Eye's brand activating within Ling Yuan—was this a warning, or a declaration of war? He毫不犹豫地催动 the Tianji Record Fragment without hesitation, a strand of golden light entering Ling Yuan's body, forcibly suppressing that暴走 black pattern. Ling Yuan gasped heavily, terror flickering in his turbid eyes: "It, it sensed..." His voice trembled. "Young master, it is watching us!"

dialogue.content: At this moment, Ling Yuan's body suddenly stiffened. His eyes became vacant and pitch-black, the original turbid whites replaced by endless abyss. A pressure beyond mortal will erupted from his body, the night wind suddenly stopping, even the moonlight seeming to dim several degrees. An ancient, vast voice exploded in Chen Ji's mind: "Chen Xuan's son... have you finally reached this step?"

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Eye had actually descended directly through Ling Yuan's consciousness! This was a life-and-death decision—to fight or retreat?

choices.description: Urge the full power of the Tianji Record to engage in an consciousness-level clash with the Heavenly Eye, even knowing the danger, to probe the enemy's details
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key information about the Heavenly Eye's weakness
choices.risk_hint: Heavy consumption of Heavenly Fate Value, and may be 反噬 by the Heavenly Eye

text.content: A trace of determination flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. The Tianji Record Fragment in his palm bloomed with unprecedented brilliance. He opened his mouth and spat a golden sword glow that pierced toward Ling Yuan—or rather, toward that existence inhabiting Ling Yuan's body. Ling Yuan's lips slightly parted, emitting an entirely different voice: "Interesting... the Tianji Record has acknowledged you to this degree. But do you think, with a mere mortal body, you can peer into heavenly secrets?"

choices.description: Do not confront the Heavenly Eye directly, preserve strength and wait for the right moment, while using words to probe its true intentions
choices.visible_cost: Miss the opportunity to obtain key intelligence
choices.visible_reward: Preserve Heavenly Fate Value, maintain room for maneuvering

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's gaze flickered slightly, the golden light in his palm secretly收敛. He stepped back, an expression of恰到好处的 fear and reverence appearing on his face: "This junior dares not. It's just... since the senior has already manifested, why not appear and meet in person? Speaking through another's body somewhat loses the Heavenly Way's dignity." His voice was respectful, yet hidden within were three parts probing and seven parts guard. Ling Yuan—or rather, the Heavenly Eye—traces of amusement flickered in those pitch-black eyes: "You indeed have composure."

text.content: The Heavenly Will within Ling Yuan seemed to be审视 something. In those pitch-black eyes, a faint galaxy seemed to revolve. After a moment, it emitted a meaningful轻笑: "Interesting... you are entirely different from Chen Xuan. His choice was to die alone, while you..." The voice suddenly paused. "Will you become my finest chess piece, or personally overturn the chessboard? Let me await and see." As the voice faded, that pressure beyond mortal will receded like a tide. Ling Yuan's whole body softened, falling directly backward.

Chen Ji acted swiftly, catching Ling Yuan. Where his hand touched was cold as iron—the old elder's vitality was rapidly draining. The Tianji Record Fragment trembled again. Mo Xiansheng's urgent voice rang out: "Young master, the Heavenly Eye took most of his essence and spirit when it withdrew! If not treated in time, he won't last another hour!" Chen Ji's expression slightly darkened. In his mind, he rapidly weighed pros and cons—to save or not? Was Ling Yuan a key chess piece to break the局, or a poison snake not yet revealed?

dialogue.content: Just as Chen Ji was weighing, Ling Yuan's tightly closed eyes slightly trembled. He struggled to raise his hand,死死 gripping Chen Ji's sleeve, his pale lips艰难地 moving: "Young master... the jade slip... the last page..." The voice was faint as a mosquito's whine, each word seemingly consuming his final vitality. "That is... what I witnessed with my own eyes as a child... the Tianji Record's... true..." Before he could finish, his fingers limply fell, his eyelids heavily closed, only one breath of残气 keeping him alive.

text.content: The night wind再度拂过 the cliff's edge, bringing distant rumbling thunder. Chen Ji低头看着 the barely-breathing Ling Yuan, a complex light flickering in his eyes. The Heavenly Eye's试探, Ling Yuan's surrender, the unopened secrets in the jade slip... tonight's information volume was truly overwhelming, requiring time to carefully digest. But one thing was very clear to him—from this moment on, there was no more turning余地 between him and the Heavenly Eye. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again, carrying a hint of gravity: "Young master, whatever decision you make, this old servant supports you. But... time is running out."

Chen Ji沉默片刻. In the end, he took a healing elixir from his sleeve and placed it in Ling Yuan's mouth. Regardless of whether this old fox was真心 or feigning, at least for now, he still had use value. Ling Yuan's breathing gradually stabilized. Chen Ji扶 him to lean against a rock to the side, then took out that intelligence jade slip, his divine sense probing within—he wanted to personally see what secret the last page of this jade slip concealed. Moonlight poured down. On the cliff's edge, the chessboard of destiny was quietly turning.
